description: getTransferQuote: Get a transfer price quote for a domain. Requires authentication. Returns the total transfer price (what initiateTransfer charges, fees included), currency, years added to the registration, and when the quote expires. Call before initiateTransfer to show the user the cost.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to quote, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getTransferQuote
